About Chauffit:

  • Chauffit is a safety-first, on-demand driver service for people who own a car but can't always, or shouldn't, drive it themselves. Customers book a professionally verified and assessed driver within minutes, for their own car, and pay only for the trip.

About the Role:

  • As our External Operations Associate, you will own everything that happens on the ground. You will build our driver and biker supply, set up and manage the partners we depend on, and open new areas and channels as we grow across Gurugram.
  • This is a field role that combines operations and business development. Some days you will be onboarding drivers; other days you will be pitching a club, a bar or a residents' association. In the early weeks after launch you will also be the first responder when a trip needs urgent help.

Location: Gurugram (field-based, on-ground)

Type: Full-time

Salary: ₹3.6 - 4.2 LPA 

Start date: 16 November 2026

What Success Looks Like:

  • First 30 days: Run a repeatable driver and biker onboarding process, from sourcing to verification to training, and have our core vendors (training, uniforms) delivering on time
  • First 60 days: Bring live partnerships with clubs, bars and residential societies that send us bookings, each tracked from first contact to first trip
  • First 90 days: Own the playbook for opening a new area: supply, partners and on-ground readiness, with the numbers to show it works

Key Responsibilities:

  • Driver and biker onboarding
    • Source drivers and bikers through referrals, local networks, job boards and on-ground drives
    • Run document collection, background verification and assessment for every partner
    • Coordinate training and uniforms so each partner is road-ready on day one
    • Keep the supply pipeline and partner records current
  • Vendor and partner management
    • Manage our third-party partners, including the driving school that trains our drivers and the uniform supplier
    • Negotiate terms, track deliveries and fix issues before they reach customers
  • Business development and expansion
    • Pitch and close partnerships with clubs, bars, residents' welfare associations (RWAs) and other local channels
    • Follow up on leads and keep a partner tracker with status and next steps
    • Scout new areas and prepare supply and partners before each one goes live
  • On-ground support
    • Handle SOS and urgent trip issues in the early launch phase, and escalate to the founders when needed
    • Oversee the kiosk during night operations, ensuring it is staffed, operational and running smoothly
    • Support launch events, society activations and kiosks with the marketing team
  • Share a weekly update on supply, partners and issues, with what to fix next

Requirements:

  • 1–3 years in field operations, supply onboarding, business development or partnerships (strong freshers with on-ground experience are welcome)
  • Comfortable spending most of the day in the field across Gurugram, including some evenings and weekends around launch
  • Confident in Hindi and English, able to talk with drivers, vendors and venue managers alike
  • Organised with trackers in Google Sheets/Excel, and quick to follow up
  • Calm and practical under pressure, with high ownership
  • Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence

Good to Have:

  • Experience in mobility, ride-hailing, logistics or quick commerce operations (driver or delivery partner onboarding)
  • An existing network of drivers, clubs, bars or RWAs in Gurugram
  • Experience negotiating with vendors

What We Offer:

  • Build Chauffit's on-ground operations from launch day, working directly with the founders
  • Real ownership: your playbook becomes how we open every new area
  • A fast learning curve across operations, partnerships and growth
  • An open culture where your ideas from the field shape the product
  • A clear path to lead an operations team as we expand

Chauffit is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, caste, religion, disability, sexual orientation, age or background. All applications are evaluated solely on merit.

  • Shift: Fixed Night Shift, Monday to Saturday, 12:30 AM – 8:30 AM IST (North American business hours)

About Us

Growpath Capital is an established firm that helps small and mid-sized businesses in the US and Canada get the business funding they need to grow, mainly through merchant cash advance (MCA) funding. Our sales team works fully remotely from India. We are growing our outbound team and want experienced MCA sellers who enjoy making calls and closing deals.

What Is An MCA?

A merchant cash advance (MCA) is fast funding for small businesses. The funder buys a share of the business's future sales and pays a lump sum upfront, and the business repays it from its sales, daily or weekly. Funding usually arrives within 24 to 72 hours.

Clients include restaurants, trucking and transportation companies, construction and skilled trades, retail shops, medical and dental clinics, salons, auto shops, e-commerce sellers, and more.

Role brief

This is a field sales role. You will spend most of your working day in the market, not in an office, and you will start in a Tier 3 town or city rather than a metro.

  • You will be in the market on roughly 20 to 25 days a month, visiting dealers, distributors and retail outlets.
  • A typical day starts in the market by mid-morning and involves visiting 12 to 20 outlets on a fixed beat plan, mostly on a two-wheeler and on foot.
  • You will be placed in a Tier 3 town or city where we have business — not a metro, and not necessarily your home state. This holds for your initial period. Larger territories in Tier 2 cities come later, for those identified as high potential.
  • Saturdays are working days. Market holidays vary by region and may not match a standard weekend.
  • This is not a desk role, a marketing role or an analytics role. Reporting and system entries are part of the job, but they happen around market working, not instead of it.

If that sounds like the kind of work you want, read on. If it does not, this is not the right role for you — and that is a perfectly reasonable conclusion to reach.

Your first six months: Click Here

There are structured check-ins through this period with your mentor and business head, so you always know where you stand. Confirmation follows at six months, based on your progress.

After confirmation - Territory Sales In-charge

You own a set of outlets in a Tier 3 market. Broadly, that means:

  • Delivering secondary sales for your outlets, and growing the retailer base
  • Managing dealer and distributor relationships, including stock, claims and collections
  • Expanding reach — adding outlets, improving counter share, placing new products
  • Executing schemes and promotions, and tracking what they deliver
  • Reading your market — competition activity, pricing movement, demand shifts — and reporting it back

  • Resilience. Some days you will hear no more often than yes.
  • Willingness to travel and to relocate
  • Self-direction. Nobody is watching you in the market; you set your own pace.

Who this role suits

  • You want to learn how a business actually makes money, at the point where it happens
  • You are energised by being out and about rather than at a desk
  • You want a clear, performance-linked path into sales leadership

Who it does not suit

  • You are looking for a corporate or head-office role
  • You want predictable hours in a fixed location
  • You would prefer a strategy, marketing or analytics profile

Where this leads

Territory Sales In-charge → Territory Sales Manager → Area Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager → National Sales Manager. Movement is based on performance.
